question: Does C3 add predictive information beyond the signalled action and early elbow history for subsequent right-elbow displacement?
known_before_freeze: Source inspection previously disclosed one S1 run 1 flexion case (+0.10314178466796875 native units). No other trial target was inspected by the fitting team before this specification.
source: Ofner et al., version 1, doi:10.5281/zenodo.834976. Only S1 right-arm motor execution runs 1,2,3. No other person, run or imagery.
selection: All chronological 0x600 and 0x601 onsets with corresponding 0x8600/0x8601 event exactly 1536 EEG ticks later, six per cue per run. Stop on unexpected counts, missing boundaries, nonfinite samples or incomplete coverage. No movement-size or sign exclusions.
cutoff: At event tick t on the 512 Hz clock, cutoff t+128 and endpoint t+512. Elbow index is floor(tick/8) on native 64 Hz clock. Use last 32 elbow rows inclusive at cutoff, partition chronologically into four disjoint 8-row medians m0...m3. Target is median of last 8 elbow rows inclusive at endpoint minus m3. Features never use samples after cutoff.
signal: One-based channel 28 C3, and all of 62,63,64 as EOG control. Four disjoint 64-tick raw sample means per channel from t-127 through t+128 inclusive, indexed s0...s3. Eye control takes the arithmetic mean of the three EOG channels' four bin means before feature generation. No filtering, re-referencing, interpolation or later samples.
features: cue01=0 for flexion, 1 for extension. Mechanics [cue01,m3,m3-m2,m2-m1,m1-m0]. Addition appends [s1-s0,s2-s0,s3-s0]. Eye control substitutes eye means for C3 means with identical features.
models: Persistence predicts 0. Cue baseline is the training median per cue. Ridge models standardize each feature with training-only mean and population SD (exact zero replaced by 1), centre the target by training mean, and solve squared error + 6 times sum of squared coefficients; intercept unpenalized. Fixed penalty 6; no tuning or variant search.
attention: Exploratory four-bin frozen scalar temporal attention; same cue+mechanics backbone, plus one pooled C3 feature. Centre the four signal means within each trial by subtracting s0, and divide by training RMS of all four resulting values (zero replaced by 1). Clip normalized tokens to [-4,4]. Logits equal last token times each token, plus fixed recency bias [-0.75,-0.50,-0.25,0]. Softmax weighted average of clipped tokens supplies the extra feature. Same ridge head and outer folds. No fitted query/key/value transforms, no prior pretrained weights, no optimization of an encoder or hyperparameters, no full Transformer claim.
swap: Fixed-model test-time control. Evaluate fitted C3 ridge on each held run after replacing all four C3 means with the next chronological trial of the same cue in that run, wrapping last to first. Preserve recipients' cue and mechanics. Training data aligned and unchanged; no held target defines mapping. This offline pairing test is not a deployable input.
folds: Leave one entire development run out (12 scored, 24 fit in each). For each fold all learned parameters, reference values and scales depend on the other two runs only. Refit on all 36 solely for illustrative inference. No independent-person test or CI.
metrics: Primary run/cue balanced native-unit MAE = unweighted mean of six run-by-cue MAEs. Also disclose all six cells with denominators, both cue means, each run mean, pooled MAE, counts for abs(target)<=0.1 native units and sign opposite to that trial's training-cue median. Zero excluded only from opposite-sign count, retained in losses. No physical sign assumption.
decision: Report support for the added C3 features in this pilot only if balanced MAE is strictly below cue+mechanics, EOG replacement and the shifted C3 pairing, and C3 improves over mechanics in both cue groups and in at least two of three runs. Otherwise report no consistent incremental evidence. Attention is a secondary architecture comparison and cannot rescue the primary decision.
distribution: Public outputs contain aggregate fitted weights, training-only scope and summary scores, fixed equations and invented input. No raw traces, private identifiers, trial features/predictions, empirical exemplar library or assessment data.
